entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?

Hi Diana. I'm calling about a VeloBand GPS Tracker I bought. I've had it for about three weeks, and to be honest, it's just not what I was expecting. I know I'm a bit outside the usual two-week window for most electronics, but I was hoping we could work something out. Maybe a partial credit?
I see. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, is there a technical fault with the device, or is it more of a personal preference?
It's just preference. The band works perfectly fine, but I just don't like the way it feels on my wrist while I'm running. It's a bit bulkier than I thought.

I understand completely. Getting the right fit is important. Now, generally, after this amount of time has passed, it can be too late to process a return for a wearable item. Our standard sanitation policy is quite strict on that for hygiene reasons.
Right, I get the hygiene part. Is there any flexibility in that policy? Even a discount on a future purchase would be helpful.
Let me just pull up your order details and review the exact terms for your purchase. One moment... Okay, I have your file here... Ah! Actually, it looks like you're in luck.
Your VeloBand was purchased under our 90-day return policy. You are well within that timeframe. I can absolutely approve a full refund for you.
Wow, seriously? That's fantastic! I was fully prepared to negotiate for half of that. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome. I'm processing the return authorization now. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be issued.
That's perfect. This was much easier than I expected. I really appreciate your help, Diana.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
